abstract_en: A hybrid course on how cities can shift from car-based transport to walking, cycling and public transport, with a focus on planning tools and citizen participation.
description_en: Online lectures present planning concepts, traffic modelling and the economics of mobility. Two workshop days in Westmark let students map the street space of a neighbourhood, measure traffic flows and develop a redesign proposal that is discussed with residents.
learning_outcomes_en: Evaluate the sustainability of a mobility system; use basic traffic and accessibility indicators; design a street redesign proposal; run a participatory workshop.
prerequisites_en: Introductory planning, geography or engineering at Bachelor level.
assessment_en: Mapping assignment (30%), redesign proposal (50%) and workshop facilitation (20%).
instructors: Lecturer in Urban Planning|Transport engineer, Westmark city lab
methods_en: Online lectures, two on-site workshop days and a design project.

abstract_en: A joint online course of two universities on how European institutions and international law contribute to peace, justice and the rule of law.
description_en: The course follows the history of European integration as a peace project and looks at courts, human rights mechanisms, sanctions and mediation. Lectures alternate between the two teaching universities; seminars bring students of both together.
learning_outcomes_en: Explain the role of European and international institutions in preventing conflict; analyse a landmark court decision; compare mediation and sanctions as instruments; defend a position in a moot discussion.
prerequisites_en: None. Some familiarity with the European Union is helpful.
assessment_en: Seminar contributions (25%), a case note (35%) and an oral moot discussion (40%).
instructors: Professor of International Law|Lecturer in Political Science
methods_en: Joint lectures, small-group seminars and a moot discussion.
remarks_en: Taught jointly with a second university of the alliance; the timetable follows Westmark time.
